Founded by Griselda Xhaferi and Gent Zambaku, the startup is building a reliable, explainable, private, and secure solution that supports space operations engineers, executives, domain experts, business users in making faster, more confident decisions, even during mission-critical scenarios. Every user can ask questions to CognitX in Natural Language and get actionable insights, personalized based on their role and needs, for smarter and faster datadriven business decisions. CognitX gets connected across data sources, to ensure unified insights and informed space data analytics, without storing or duplicating the data. At the core of the system is a proprietary compiler that ensures accurate data analysis across diverse formats, paired with a semantic layer that enables contextualized analytics and intuitive query responses. CognitX for space operations: • AI-powered anomaly detection in satellite telemetry • Natural language queries across complex mission data • EO data analysis to improve terrestrial infrastructure and monitoring The solution bridges Earth-space insights while supporting real-time analytics needs in space missions.

The CyStellar platform integrates, manages, and secures data from Internet of Things (IoT) ground sensors, aerial surveillance, and ESA satellite imagery at a massive scale.
